templates.pat: TargetScan predicts biological targets of miRNAs by searching for the presence of conserved {{1}}, {{2}}, and {{3}} sites that match the {{4}} of each miRNA ({{5}}). As options, predictions with only poorly conserved sites and predictions with nonconserved miRNAs are also provided. Also identified are sites with mismatches in the seed region that are compensated by conserved 3' pairing ({{6}}). In mammals, predictions are ranked based on the predicted efficacy of targeting as calculated using a biochemical model of miRNA-mediated repression, which was extended to all miRNA sequences using a convolutional neural network ({{7}}). As an option, predictions are also ranked on the basis of targeting efficacy estimated using cumulative weighted {{8}} of the sites ({{9}}). As another option, predictions are ranked by their probability of conserved targeting ({{10}}, {{11}}). TargetScanHuman considers matches to human {{12}} and their orthologs, as defined by {{13}}. Conserved targeting has also been detected within open reading frames (ORFs). A listing of these ORF sites can be found at the bottom of {{14}} of {{15}}.
templates.zh: TargetScan 通过检索与每个 miRNA 的 {{4}} 匹配的保守 {{1}}、{{2}} 和 {{3}} 位点来预测 miRNA 的生物学靶标（{{5}}）。此外还提供仅含弱保守位点的预测和含非保守 miRNA 的预测。种子区域存在错配、但由保守的 3' 配对补偿的位点也会被识别（{{6}}）。在哺乳动物中，预测结果依据 miRNA 介导抑制的生化模型算出的预测靶向效力排序，该模型通过卷积神经网络扩展到了所有 miRNA 序列（{{7}}）。作为可选方案，预测结果也可依据各位点累积加权 {{8}} 估算的靶向效力排序（{{9}}）。另一种可选方案是按保守靶向概率（{{10}}，{{11}}）排序。TargetScanHuman 考虑与人类 {{12}} 及其直系同源序列的匹配，直系同源由 {{13}} 定义。在开放阅读框（ORF）内也检测到保守靶向。这些 ORF 位点的列表见 {{14}}（{{15}}）文末。

templates.pat: This search page of TargetScan Release 8.0 retrieves predicted regulatory targets of {{1}}. The predicted targets are essentially the same as those presented in previous versions of the TargetScan site ({{2}}, {{3}}, {{4}}, {{5}}, {{6}}, {{7}}, {{8}}, {{9}}, and {{10}}{{11}}; {{12}}; {{13}}; {{14}}; {{15}}). Thus Release 8 uses the same {{16}} as Release 7 and the same {{17}}, which were curated from {{18}} and {{19}}. Compared to previous releases, Release 8 provides a new option for ranking mammalian predictions; by default, these predictions are ranked using the new biochemical model ({{20}}).
templates.zh: TargetScan 版本 8.0 的本检索页用于检索 {{1}} 的预测调控靶标。所预测的靶标与 TargetScan 网站以往版本（{{2}}、{{3}}、{{4}}、{{5}}、{{6}}、{{7}}、{{8}}、{{9}} 和 {{10}}{{11}}；{{12}}；{{13}}；{{14}}；{{15}}）展示的基本相同。因此版本 8 与版本 7 使用相同的 {{16}} 和相同的 {{17}}，后者整理自 {{18}} 和 {{19}}。与以往版本相比，版本 8 为哺乳动物预测结果的排序提供了新选项；默认情况下，这些预测使用新的生化模型（{{20}}）排序。
